svg.text: CRW-04 — Change Verification route: /t/acme/changes/change_01/verification params: none pattern: R-CHANGE

states: not-ready → prerequisite link only; ready manual → Run now behind billable confirmation; verifying/queued → run link, cannot start again; failed rerunnable → Rerun + the raised billable confirmation panel; stale bound to revision 6 stays distinct; override never converts a failure
links: View missing Evidence → Evidence detail; View run → run inspection; findings → failure report; Rerun → confirm panel
